items.name: Rush Draught
items.description: A rough stimulant salvaged from aggressive ingredients.

effects.description: Adds a brief burst of hurried motion.

items.name: Delayed Stamina Tonic
items.description: A stamina tonic held in reserve before it surges through the body.

effects.description: Builds into a longer, steadier rush.

items.name: Stamina Tonic
items.description: A sharp tonic that steadies breath and motion.

effects.description: Quickens movement and lightens the body.

items.name: Trailblaze Tonic
items.description: A hot desert-and-ember tonic that keeps repair crews moving through a long shift.

effects.description: Drives a strong, sustained push of energy.

items.name: Wildfire Draught
items.description: A fierce overcharged stimulant that should be handed out with a warning.

effects.description: Unleashes a hard, long-burning surge of speed.

items.name: Sunwarden Tonic
items.description: A warming tonic that steadies the body against desert heat and long exposed roads.

effects.description: Keeps footing sure and warm across hard ground.

items.name: Briskstep Draught
items.description: A gentle, well-mannered pick-me-up for elders and anyone who dislikes a jolt.

effects.description: Lends a light, even quickness with no rough edge.

items.name: Quickfire Draught
items.description: Briskstep pushed with kiln heat. It moves you faster than you meant to go, which is the point and also the problem.

effects.description: A hard, short burst of speed that is difficult to steer.

items.name: Pollenwind Draught
items.description: Bloomwing pollen taken up in sunspike heat. It moves you the way the drift moves: light, fast, and not quite in a straight line.

effects.description: A long, buoyant lift to the stride that outlasts most errands.
Takes the ache out of a long walking day.

items.name: Relay Draught
items.description: Briskstep threaded through an echo rune. The lift fades, and then some minutes later it comes back, which is either a gift or a nuisance depending where you are standing.

effects.description: A moderate lift that drops away and returns before it finishes.

items.name: Firstthaw Draught
items.description: Pale and slow to start. It does nothing for a good while and then arrives all at once, exactly like the thing it is made of.

effects.description: Nothing, and then a hard sustained lift for the rest of its run.

items.name: Hardwinter Draught
items.description: A frostcrack seed opened by kiln heat instead of by weather. It is the only way anyone has found to argue with the calendar, and it is expensive.

effects.description: A long hard lift that does not taper the way a draught should.
Keeps the cold out for as long as it runs.

items.name: Forgestep Tonic
items.description: Tastes like a smithy and works like one. The road crews have opinions about it and take it anyway.

effects.description: A hard steady lift with no subtlety in it at all.
